以能源支撑人工智能发展、人工智能赋能能源转型为主线，行动方案聚焦保障算力设施安全: With energy supporting AI development and AI empowering energy transformation as the main theme, the action plan focuses on ensuring safe and reliable energy supply for computing power facilities, promoting green and low-carbon transformation of computing power facilities, facilitating efficient and economical coordination of computing power and electricity, opening high-value AI application scenarios in the energy sector, tapping data value in the energy field, and strengthening AI model innovation in the energy sector, deploying 29 key tasks and striving to promote efficient coordination of energy, computing power, scenarios, data, models, and other elements of AI development

当生成式人工智能深度介入艺术创作（艺坛走笔）: When generative artificial intelligence deeply intervenes in artistic creation (Art and Culture)
当下，人工智能深入社会与产业的各个方面，掀起新的变革浪潮: Currently, artificial intelligence is penetrating every aspect of society and industry, sparking a new wave of transformation
当生成式人工智能深度介入艺术创作，既为其带来活力，也引发对一系列问题的关注与讨论: As generative artificial intelligence deeply intervenes in artistic creation, it both brings vitality and raises attention to and discussion of a series of questions: Can it replace artists
随着大语言模型和多模态模型快速发展，自然语言交互逐渐成为人机协同创作的基本方式: With the rapid development of large language models and multimodal models, natural language interaction has gradually become the basic mode of human-machine collaborative creation
事实上，生成式人工智能对不同艺术门类的作用并不相同，介入程度也各有不同: In fact, generative artificial intelligence has different effects on different art forms, with varying degrees of intervention
比如影像创作领域，独立创作者能够借助生成式人工智能，通过提示词直接完成脚本、分镜: For example, in the field of video production, independent creators can leverage generative artificial intelligence to directly complete scripts, shot lists, visuals, music, and post-production style generation through prompts, substantially compressing or even eliminating original creative links that relied on multi-person collaboration and physical operations
具体到美术领域，如果将美术依然理解为与某种载体、手工创造相关联的造型艺术，一旦有: Specifically in the visual arts field, if visual art is still understood as figurative art related to certain media and handicraft, once generative artificial intelligence intervenes, its creative process will change
而生成式人工智能介入美术创作，首先介入的是创作前端的视觉想象与方案生成，而非直接: Rather, generative artificial intelligence's intervention in visual art creation first intervenes at the front end of visual imagination and scheme generation in the creative process, rather than directly eliminating drawing, sculpting, and making
可见，生成式人工智能对美术创作的冲击，不是简单地取代艺术家，而是重组了创作流程内: It is thus evident that the impact of generative artificial intelligence on visual art creation is not simply replacing artists, but rather reorganizing the relative weight of various links within the creative process
这意味着，正确认识人工智能与美术创作的关系，应从这一结构性变化出发，而不是从“是: This means that correctly understanding the relationship between artificial intelligence and visual art creation should proceed from this structural change, rather than from the superficial judgment of "whether it replaces"
重新界定主体位置，是生成式人工智能带给我们的价值参照: Redefining the position of the subject is the value reference that generative artificial intelligence brings to us
与之前摄影术出现时相似，生成式人工智能同样让创作者面对一种新的视觉生成机制，并迫: Similar to when photography emerged before, generative artificial intelligence likewise confronts creators with a new visual generation mechanism, forcing people to rethink which abilities can be taken over by technology and which abilities need to be redefined and maintained by creators
生成式人工智能触动的是构图、组合、风格模拟乃至艺术观念等更接近人的“思维活动”: Generative artificial intelligence touches upon composition, combination, style simulation, and even artistic concepts—all closer to human "thinking activity"
生成式人工智能正在由单一辅助工具，转为参与文化生产的“准主体”，这在当下的艺术创: Generative artificial intelligence is transitioning from a single auxiliary tool to a "quasi-subject" participating in cultural production, which is particularly sensitive in the current context of artistic creation
这时，问题不再是生成式人工智能创作能不能成为艺术，而是在生成式人工智能大量参与的: At this point, the question is no longer whether art created by generative artificial intelligence can become art, but rather, in the context of generative artificial intelligence's massive participation, what should art be defined by
回到新大众文艺的讨论语境，生成式人工智能介入美术创作也成为破除专业垄断、重新分配: Returning to the discussion context of new mass culture and art, generative artificial intelligence's intervention in visual art creation has also become a breakthrough for eliminating professional monopoly, redistributing cultural power, and restructuring the creative system
利用生成式人工智能进行创作，可以直接绕过某些旧有的训练路径，同时也对创作者提出了: Utilizing generative artificial intelligence for creation can directly bypass certain old training paths, while simultaneously imposing new capability requirements on creators, such as prompt organization, model comprehension, image selection, style judgment, and cross-media integration
这说明生成式人工智能并不消解专业性，而是在重塑专业性的内容与形态: This demonstrates that generative artificial intelligence does not dissolve professionalism, but rather reshapes its content and form
生成式人工智能的介入，直接冲击着美术创作中的垄断性结构：其一是削弱传统专业技术对: The intervention of generative artificial intelligence directly impacts monopolistic structures in visual art creation: first, it weakens the exclusive dominance of traditional professional techniques over creative entry, enabling those who do not master academic methods to participate in visual production
只有创作权、传播权与评价权都发生重组，生成式人工智能所带来的新大众美术浪潮，才可: Only when creation rights, distribution rights, and evaluation rights all undergo restructuring can the new mass visual art wave brought by generative artificial intelligence drive a more structurally significant cultural transformation
从本质上看，生成式人工智能是一种基于既有数据的、高度复杂的风格化重组与演绎: Essentially, generative artificial intelligence is a highly complex stylistic recombination and interpretation based on existing data
就目前而言，生成式人工智能缺乏艺术家最根本的创作源泉——基于肉身的个体情感体验: For now, generative artificial intelligence lacks the most fundamental creative source of artists—individual emotional experience based on embodied existence
由此，面对生成式人工智能，应将其视为一种激发创意、拓展想象、丰富表达的共创工具，: Therefore, facing generative artificial intelligence, it should be viewed as a co-creative tool for inspiring creativity, expanding imagination, and enriching expression, rather than allowing it to create entirely on its own
总而言之，人工智能时代，艺术的质态正面临前所未有的更新与重构: In summary, in the age of artificial intelligence, the nature of art is facing unprecedented renewal and reconstruction
正确认识人工智能与美术创作的关系，厘清艺术的本体价值，有助于更好地实现人机共创，: Correctly understanding the relationship between artificial intelligence and visual art creation, clarifying the ontological value of art, helps achieve better human-machine co-creation and opens up more new artistic possibilities
